parts.name: Fan cover
parts.what: Covers the motor's cooling fan on its top end and guides the cooling air down along the motor's fins. A blocked or damaged cover lets the motor run hot.

parts.name: Motor
parts.what: Drives the pump. On a close-coupled in-line pump it stands on top and its shaft turns the impeller through a coupling; its terminal box takes the supply cable.

parts.name: Lantern and coupling guard
parts.what: Holds the motor on the pump. Inside it: the coupling that joins the motor shaft to the pump shaft, and below it the shaft seal where the shaft enters the pump; the guard covers the turning coupling.

parts.name: Pump cover and volute casing
parts.what: The volute casing holds the impeller and turns the flow it throws out into pressure; both ports sit on one axis (in-line). The cover bolted on top closes it. The impeller inside is not modelled: that needs the vendor's CAD.

parts.name: Pipe connection, port 1
parts.what: The connected pipework: a counter-flange bolted to the pump's port flange (gasket between them), a short spool and the next flange joint. Which port is suction and which discharge is not known from the scan.
parts.why: port 1's pipework: its flange joint sits 17.5 mm from the photo's joint line (frame 58); shown in place, not a part

parts.name: Pipe connection, port 2
parts.what: The connected pipework: a counter-flange bolted to the pump's port flange (gasket between them), a short spool and the next flange joint. Which port is suction and which discharge is not known from the scan.

parts.name: Pedestal with feet
parts.what: Carries the pump's weight so the pipework does not have to; bolted down through its feet.
parts.why: pedestal: the AI-inferred box does not match the photos (the real pump stands on a frame of steel bars); shown in place, not a part

check.match_rule: a coherent photo edge (the gradient across the cut averaged along the whole boundary, 1.5x its median or more) within 8 mm
check.registration: 2D scale + shift of the whole model's silhouette onto the unit's photo mask (the placement's own error)

parts.name: Motor head
parts.what: The circulator's motor with its control box in one head, bolted onto the side of the pump housing; the control box takes the supply cable. On a wet-rotor circulator the rotor runs in the pumped water (no coupling, no shaft seal), so the head comes off as one piece.

parts.name: Pump housing
parts.what: The in-line pump housing: both ports on one axis (here the pipe runs up through it, flanged above and below). It holds the impeller and turns its flow into pressure, and stays in the pipework when the motor head is changed. The impeller inside is not modelled: that needs the vendor's CAD.

parts.name: Pipe connection, top
parts.what: The connected pipework above the pump: the counter-flange bolted to the housing's flange (gasket between them) and the fitting above it.
parts.why: the pipework above: its flange joint meets a coherent photo edge in frame 0006 (-3.5 mm) and held-out 0311 but not in input frame 0319 (1.31x, under 1.5x); shown in place, not a part

parts.name: Pipe connection, bottom
parts.what: The connected pipework below the pump: the counter-flange bolted to the housing's flange (gasket between them) and what hangs below it.
parts.why: the pipework below: its flange joint meets a coherent photo edge only in frame 0006 (-3.5 mm), not in 0319 or held-out 0311; shown in place, not a part
